next.reason: 1985: "must contain at least one 'B' or '0' (zero) or '/' (slant)"; 2023: "at least one instance of character-1 or one of the symbols from the set 'B', '0', '/'". Both require at least one A or X plus an insertion symbol. 2023 adds character-1 (an EDITING-phrase insertion symbol) as a further way to make an item alphanumeric-edited.
